A sample of a hydrate of barium chloride
weighing 61 g was heated until all the
water of hydration is removed.  The dried
sample weighed 52 g.  The formula of the
hydrated salt is : (atomic mass,
Ba5137 amu, Cl535.5 amu)

Which of the following is not an
assumption of the kinetic theory of gases ?

options.A: A gas consists of many identical particles which are in continual motion.
options.C: At high pressure, gas particles are difficult to compress.
options.D: Collisions of gas particles are perfectly elastic.

questions.text:
If the principal quantum number n56, the
correct sequence of filling of electrons will
be :

After understanding the assertion and
reason, choose the correct option.
Assertion : In the bonding molecular
orbital (MO) of H2, electron
density is increased between
the nuclei.
Reason :
The bonding MO is cA1cB,
which shows destructive
interference of the combining
electron waves.

options.A: Assertion and reason are correct and reason is the correct explanation for the assertion.
options.B: Assertion and reason are correct, but reason is not the correct explanation for the assertion.
options.C: Assertion is correct, reason is incorrect.
options.D: Assertion is incorrect, reason is correct.
